note: Abilities that contribute partial weight to role scoring beyond raw stats. Weights are additive bonuses to the stat-derived role weight, capped at 1.0 by the consumer. Some abilities (Multiscale) contribute to multiple roles; some (Levitate) carry a coverage-side flag rather than a role weight.

_reserved_sentinel_roles.ground_immunity_flag: Set role to this sentinel + is_coverage_hint=true to mark the ability as Ground-immunity-granting. Consumer translates this into coverage_flags['ground_immune']=True and does NOT add weight to any real role. Used by Levitate.
